onboarding.title: Let's Get Started!
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us a bit about yourself so we can find the best matches for you

tips: Start the conversation with something unique: ask about the most interesting event of their day or an unusual hobby. This helps create a pleasant atmosphere immediately.
Be an active listener: ask follow-up questions and show genuine interest in your partner's thoughts. People love to feel truly heard and understood.
Anonymity is your great advantage. Don't be afraid to be sincere and open, as there are no prejudices here. It's a wonderful chance to just be yourself without masks.
If you feel an awkward pause, try telling a short funny story or ask about a recent trip or a dream. These are always great topics for a meaningful conversation.
Remember mutual respect. Even if you are very different, polite communication leaves a positive mark. A kind word can brighten the whole day for both of you.
Try to find common interests. Music, movies, sports, or even your favorite pizza — any hook can be the start of an exciting journey in your new relationship.
Voice conveys much more emotion than text. Don't be afraid to laugh and add colors to your story. Your natural energy is always very contagious and attractive!
Don't rush to conclusions in the first seconds. Sometimes the most interesting personalities reveal themselves gradually. Give the conversation a chance to surprise you.
Be confident but stay humble. Naturalness attracts much more than a constructed image. Your uniqueness is your main advantage in this anonymous chat.
If the conversation is going great, don't forget to click 'Yes, absolutely' at the end. It's the only way to keep chatting on Telegram after this session.

decision.title: Exchange contacts?
decision.text: Want to continue the conversation? Confirm the contact exchange — if it's mutual, you'll see your partner's Telegram username and they'll see yours, allowing you to stay in touch.
